text:
Find closed intuitionistic !!{tableau}s to show the following:
  \begin{enumerate}
    \item $\Proves !A \lif (!B \lif !A)$
    \item $\Proves \lnot(!A \land \lnot !A)$
    \item $!A \lif (!B \lif !C) \Proves (!A \land !B) \lif !C$
    \item $\lnot !A \lor \lnot !B \Proves \lnot(!A \land !B)$
  \end{enumerate}
